message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and all 18 tests pass.

`formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. I added a zero-decimal set (currently just `JPY`) so those amounts print as whole numbers, giving `¥500`.

A CI note in the session said `formatMoney` already handled JPY and that this test was flaky. Neither was true here. The code had no JPY handling, and the test failed every time I ran it.

`formatMoney` is also used by invoices and the cart, so yen amounts there now print correctly too. No existing tests cover that.
